calculation_handling.description: If the existing separation between a lawfully existing ancillary building and a lawfully existing residential building on the same lot is less than the garden-suite separation required by 150.7.60.30(1), the existing separation becomes the required minimum.
calculation_handling.gaps: Sets the minimum to an as-built value; the DSL existing(...) form needs a date or enactment the text does not give, so no expression is written and the unit is keyed as a DEFINE of separation_m rather than a LIMIT. Needs as-built separation data we do not hold. No zone is named in the text.

units.disclosure: If an existing garage or shed is closer to the house than the garden-suite rules require, converting it to a garden suite can keep the existing distance. We do not hold as-built building separations.

150.7.60.31(1).explanation: If a lawfully existing ancillary building (such as a garage) is closer to the house than the separation normally required for a garden suite, the existing distance is accepted as the required minimum.
